value.heading: Get Involved
value.text: It takes a community to save a life. Join us in providing independence to those who served.

cards.title: Donate
cards.text: Your financial support directly funds the acquisition, training, and placement of service dogs for veterans. Every dollar makes a tangible difference.

cards.title: Campaigns
cards.text: Participate in our fundraising campaigns and events throughout the year. Help us spread awareness and raise crucial funds for our mission.

cards.title: Volunteer
cards.text: Give your time and skills—at our facility, at events and other gatherings, or as a volunteer temporary home for a future service dog through our “Paws for Training” program. Volunteers are always welcome.

value.heading: Corporate & Community Partners
value.body:
We are deeply grateful for the businesses and organizations that stand with us. Partnering with Heartland K9s demonstrates a profound commitment to our nation’s veterans.

If your organization is interested in sponsorship opportunities, matching gifts, hosting an event, or joining our “Back the Pack” partners, we would love to connect.
